title: Self-contained 31/10 bound with every field-prefix input bit charged

claims.statement: For the single total family G_N defined at every actual input length N in proof.md, L={z:G_|z|(z)=1} is in P and hence NP, and unconditionally liminf as N tends to infinity of C_B2(G_N)/N is at least 31/10, for deterministic acyclic one-output circuits with all 16 binary Boolean truth tables, unrestricted depth and sharing, and possibly nonuniform circuits.
